name: Global Carrier Lookup (File)
description: Upload a whole file of numbers and download the carrier data when the task finishes.

result_fields.name: identifier
result_fields.description: Submitted identifier, used to join the result to the input. Phone identifiers include their country code.

result_fields.name: carrier
result_fields.description: Carrier information returned for the number; this is not a guarantee of its current ported network.

result_fields.name: country_code
result_fields.description: Returned country/territory code; not the person’s current location.

result_fields.name: region
result_fields.description: Number-associated region when available, not precise location.

result_fields.name: city
result_fields.description: Number-associated city when available, not precise location.
